_about: Where the Studio can run its models, shown on the Models tab. 'proven' means the Studio has really run a job there. Paid providers are a research list: nothing here has been connected or tried. No prices are listed because they change; check each site.

computer.name: This computer
computer.note: Already there: its own NVIDIA (or AMD with ROCm) graphics card, no account, models download once.

free.name: Kaggle
free.note: Free weekly GPU quota. Needs a phone-verified account.

free.name: Hugging Face Spaces
free.note: Free shared GPUs with a daily quota, only for models with a public Space.

paid.name: Google Gemini API (Omni 1.2 Flash)
paid.note: Native 3-15s video + synchronized audio, up to 6 character/set reference images, 4K output, and conversational turn-by-turn editing via GEMINI_API_KEY.

paid.name: Google Colab Pro / Pro+
paid.note: The same Colab runner with L4, A100 or H100 GPUs. The GPU choices are in the Studio already; no paid run has been tried.

paid.name: RunPod
paid.note: Billed by the hour or second. Route to try: start a pod, run the Studio on it, and use it as 'This computer'.

paid.name: Vast.ai
paid.note: Cheapest listings vary by host; machines differ in speed and reliability.

paid.name: Lightning AI
paid.note: Pay-as-you-go GPU studios; a small free monthly allowance.

paid.name: Modal
paid.note: Billed per second; the Studio's scripts would need a Modal wrapper.

paid.name: Replicate
paid.note: Pay per run. Uses the provider's version of a model, not the Studio's own scripts.

paid.name: fal
paid.note: Pay per image or video. Uses the provider's version of a model.

paid.name: Together AI
paid.kind: hosted model API and GPU clusters

paid.name: Hugging Face Inference Endpoints
paid.note: Billed per hour while the endpoint runs.

paid.name: Amazon SageMaker
paid.note: Needs an AWS account and a role; heavy setup.

paid.name: Google Vertex AI
paid.note: Needs a Google Cloud project; heavy setup.

paid.name: Azure Machine Learning
paid.note: Needs an Azure subscription; heavy setup.
